reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: Section 10(a) is a broad Vendor-side defend-and-indemnify covering all third-party Claims 'arising out of or in connection with' the Services and Auction Platform, plus Kubient's breach of its representations/warranties (including IP ownership and legal compliance) and the acts or omissions of Kubient and its subcontractors — this subsumes IP infringement allegations, unlawful conduct and misconduct, so it meets or exceeds the preferred position without any need for a super-cap.
Section 11 supplies the notice/control/cooperation procedure required by the preferred position, so the procedural element is satisfied.

The failed deterministic check ('vendor indemnity for IP infringement present') is a phrasing artefact: the clause does not use the words 'infringe/misappropriate' in the Vendor limb, but its 'arising out of or in connection with the Services / Auction Platform / breach of warranty' scope is broader than an express IP carve-in, so it is not a material gap.

Correctly treated the mirrored Customer indemnity in 10(b) (which reaches misuse and Customer acts/omissions rather than being strictly limited to Customer Content and breach of law) as a rationale note rather than a deviation, consistent with the playbook's instruction not to flag minor shortfalls of preferred wording.
No redline or counterparty comment was produced, which is the expected output for a compliant finding; the finding is properly retained as internal evidence rather than raised as a negotiation issue.
